Name: More Useful Gems and Minerals - Amulet
Author: mithril1257
Description:
添加了四种护身符，使用对应矿锭+宝石制作，于铁匠处购买“镶嵌台”进行制作以及进行后续镶嵌
护身符可镶嵌所有宝石以及晶球矿物（具体增益见游戏内图鉴）
护身符可作为所有村民最喜欢的礼物送出
宝石及矿物镶嵌后提高护身符的售价将远高于宝石本身

已适配:
WearMoreRings 
Stardew Valley Expanded

语言默认跟随游戏语言设置，可切换中英文

Four types of amulets have been added. They can be made by combining the corresponding ore blocks and gems. You can purchase the "Engraving Table" from the blacksmith to create them, and then perform the subsequent engraving.
The amulets can be set with all types of gems and crystal mineral (for specific benefits, please refer to the in-game reference guide).
The amulets can be given as the favorite gifts for all villagers.
After the gems and minerals are engraved onto the amulets, their selling price will be much higher than the gems themselves.

Adapted:
Stardew Valley Expanded
WearMoreRings

The language will default to the game's language setting and can be switched between Chinese and English.
